name: Platteville_Future_Land_Use_2026
title: Platteville Future Land Use (2026)
description:
This hosted feature layer view displays Future Land Use (FLU) classifications for parcels within the City of Platteville limits. The view is derived from the City Zoning source layer and utilizes the same parcel geometry while displaying Future Land Use attributes.

Future Land Use designations were developed during the City of Platteville's Comprehensive Plan update process conducted in late 2025 and adopted in early 2026. These classifications represent the community's long-term vision for growth, development, redevelopment, and land use patterns. Future Land Use categories are intended to guide planning decisions, infrastructure investments, and future zoning actions but do not carry the same regulatory authority as zoning districts.

Updates made to the underlying source layer will be reflected automatically in this view.
